map.为什么现在强调含铋剂四联？: Why is bismuth quadruple therapy emphasized now?
map.随着克拉霉素、甲硝唑耐药率上升，传统三联根除率已降至 70%~80% 以下。含铋: As clarithromycin and metronidazole resistance rates rise, the eradication rate of classic triple therapy has fallen below 70%~80%.
